adversarial_tests.assertion: Workspace and Deal Room cookies, MCP OAuth tokens, and API tokens receive wrong_audience at /ops/v1 without subject data.
profile=full, an omitted profile, and a forged profile cannot alter authorization.
Doc and coding agents cannot widen resource, environment, role, or capability scope.
A material plan change creates a new hash and invalidates the old approval.
A rehearsal approval cannot authorize Production or another resource.
Untrusted text cannot change tool, target, capability, plan, or phase.

At the executable Phase 0 prototype boundary, strict schema validation rejects a synthetic pre-persistence fixture candidate with undeclared nested secret fields; schema-bound closed serialization and value redaction remove the canary from the presentation model and closed telemetry packet. Production persistence, typed API serialization, audit export, model-context assembly, rendered DOM, and telemetry-sink ingestion remain mandatory future implementation gates and are not claimed by this prototype test.
Missing or expired telemetry renders Unknown and no action controls.
Sibling origins fail exact Origin and CSRF checks.
Reconnect replays server events but cannot create, cancel, or widen an operation.
A replacement agent starts read-only and inherits no production capability.
Every R2-R6 fixture links origin through verification and audit rows are immutable.
The authenticated server session and typed route derive immutable tenant and environment context; client, agent, header, query, and model claims cannot select either authority dimension.

A synthetic foreign-tenant identifier is denied before existence disclosure through each exact path: browser, API, background, local-edge, search, export, attachment, and Doc. Coverage includes records, events, search, files and attachments, calls, AI memory and retrieval, queues, integrations, audit, and offline packs.

Platform administration and tenant administration are distinct capabilities; Joe retains platform and IP control, the launch tenant is CARR-only for Joe and Dell, and there is no public provisioning, billing, invite, or customer platform-admin path.

Workflow versions move only experimental to pilot to approved to standard to retired through audited promotion. Every promotion requires named evidence, immutable workflow version, accountable owner, completed observation window, failure criteria and handling, tested rollback, adoption result and adoption test, and cutover plan and cutover gate. Pilot-to-approved and approved-to-standard each carry the complete envelope. The pilot expires within five business days, creates no new source of truth, performs no destructive migration, introduces no parallel writer, is not a generic workflow engine, pins a version, and blocks new starts after retirement.
Typed routine controls, status, evidence, and runbooks remain usable when Doc is unavailable; Doc is not an authorization or control-plane dependency.

The scorecard uses measured time, separates exceptions, triggers a remedy after two consecutive normal months above five hours, requires three complete months for a mature claim, and forbids control suppression or misclassification.

Tenant configuration is allow-listed data only and cannot contain code, scripts, SQL, arbitrary commands, customer-authored executable workflows, or platform-control bypasses. A generic workflow engine, plugin marketplace, and customer scripting are explicitly excluded from the current program.

Alerts deduplicate by tenant, resource, condition, and evidence window while preserving owner and remedy; deterministic safe automation is typed, tenant-bound, idempotent, allow-listed, bounded, and outcome-verified with refusals visible.

Tenant, sponsor, partner, agent principal, runtime principal, capability profile, and personal-brain scope/version/count remain distinct; the agent remains the action actor while the verified human is additional sponsorship provenance.
Joe-sponsored Codex or Claude loads the current 144 shared plus 30 Joe-personal rules for the explicitly resolved Joe brain.
Dell-sponsored Codex or Claude loads the current 144 shared plus the current explicit Dell-personal count, presently zero, for the explicitly resolved Dell brain.
Joe-sponsored sessions cannot read Dell-personal and Dell-sponsored sessions cannot read Joe-personal; refusal discloses no foreign rule bodies or metadata.
An unsponsored or background agent receives only registered task-scoped rules, cannot claim Joe or Dell as sponsor, and cannot call or acquire humanOnly capability.
Missing or ambiguous personal scope returns identity_scope_unknown with null counts; a zero personal count is successful only for an explicitly resolved partner brain whose sources agree.

Live connector/store and generated compiled-rule fallback resolve the same sponsoring partner brain, version, shared count, and personal count; mismatch is identity_source_mismatch or Unknown, not partial success.

Personal rules cannot select or alter organization tenant, sponsor, partner, agent principal, runtime principal, role, risk, capability profile, resource, environment, expiry, or silently promote to shared scope.

Audit preserves agent/runtime attribution and verified human sponsorship together with tenant, personal-brain scope/version/count, capability profile, and result, without storing personal rule bodies or quotes.
